target.title: fix: filter braille characters from usage bar to prevent markdown rendering issues (#105481)
target.body: ## Summary Fixes #105481. Braille Unicode characters (U+2800-U+28FF) used in usage bar progress indicators were leaking into WebChat message payloads, causing markdown-it to render tool outputs as images instead of text. ## What Problem This Solves When the agent-runner renders usage bars with braille character progress indicators (e.g., `"⠐⡀⡄⡆⡇⣇⣧⣷⣿"`), these characters can interfere with markdown-it parsing. Specifically, U+2800 (braille blank character) is misinterpreted by the Uint16Array decoder as a binary/image marker, causing all tool output (exec, read, fetch, etc.) to render as attached images instead of plain text in WebChat and TUI. ## Why This Change Was Made The fix applies a minimal regex filter to remove braille characters from rendered usage bars before they are included in reply payloads. This prevents the braille characters from reaching the markdown parser while preserving the rest of the usage line formatting. ## User Impact - **Affected users**: All WebChat and TUI users when agent-runner triggers with usage bar display - **Severity**: High - blocks visibility of all tool outputs (exec, read, write, fetch) - **Frequency**: Always reproducible once braille characters enter the session via agent-runner animation ## Evidence ### Test results ``` > pnpm test src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-usage-line.test.ts Test Files 1 passed (1) Tests 1 passed (1) Duration 6.54s [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 17.16s ``` ### TypeScript type check ``` > pnpm tsgo:core [No errors - clean exit] ``` ## Changes - `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-usage-line.ts`: Added `filterBrailleCharacters()` helper function and applied it to rendered usage bar output ## Related - Closes #105481 - Affects usage bar rendering in `src/auto-reply/usage-bar/default-template.ts` which defines braille scale characters
